name: Blur
source:
A story about a miserable main character. A school dropout, a shut in, and a good for nothing son/daughter. Jobless and running out of money, you must do everything to gain money and survive. With the scary reality, you are forced to work, meet other people and develop 'love' or change your pitiful self for the best.

[Edited from [url=https://disposableteen.itch.io/blur]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个关于悲惨主角的故事。一个辍学、一个被关起来、一个没出息的儿子/女儿。失业并且钱花光了，你必须尽一切努力赚钱和生存。面对可怕的现实，你被迫工作、结识其他人、发展“爱”或改变可怜的自己。

[编辑自[url=https://disposableteen.itch.io/blur]itch.io[/url]]
